Full Disk Access-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

FDA marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general encryption or MDM guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate Full Disk Access permission claims:

完全磁盘访问 vs 完全磁盘访问权限 vs FDA 权限

US pages say "Full Disk Access", "Grant Full Disk Access", or "Enable FDA in System Settings." China storefront copy often uses 完全磁盘访问 for general Full Disk Access positioning aligned with Settings → Privacy & Security → Full Disk Access, 完全磁盘访问权限 when the hero frame shows the permission rationale or access scope, and FDA 权限 when English source uses FDA shorthand on technical buyer frames. AppLocale picks commerce-idiomatic phrasing per frame — not 隐私偏好策略控制 on consumer FDA screenshots, not FileVault 全盘加密 on grant-toggle walkthroughs, and not 隐私报告 on backup-scan onboarding.

Full Disk Access vs PPPC

Consumer Full Disk Access (完全磁盘访问) lets end users toggle per-app FDA grants in System Settings after consent. PPPC (隐私偏好策略控制) lets IT admins deploy PrivacyPreferencesPolicyControl payloads that pre-grant or deny Full Disk Access for named apps on enrolled Macs. English shares "Full Disk Access" — Chinese storefront copy must not conflate consumer 完全磁盘访问 grant panels with enterprise PPPC TCC payload editors. PPPC frames belong on the PPPC listing guide when MDM TCC grants lead — not mixed into consumer FDA captions unless each frame is labeled honestly.

Full Disk Access vs App Privacy Report and Local Network

Full Disk Access permission governs broad file-system access grants — 完全磁盘访问. App Privacy Report shows historical network and sensor access — 隐私报告. Local Network governs LAN browse on the subnet — 本地网络. An FDA grant toggle is not an access timeline chart and not a LAN discovery prompt. App Privacy Report frames belong on the App Privacy Report listing guide; Local Network frames belong on the Local Network listing guide when those features lead.

Full Disk Access vs FileVault

Per-app FDA TCC grants (完全磁盘访问) differ from full-volume FileVault encryption (FileVault 全盘加密) and Recovery Key escrow (恢复密钥). FDA permission frames need 完全磁盘访问 or FDA 权限 — not encryption-at-rest language on dedicated System Settings Full Disk Access walkthroughs unless your English source honestly shows both on separate labeled frames.
